title: Echocardiography video AI detects heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
summary: A 3D convolutional neural network on a single apical 4-chamber echo clip, trained on 2,971 cases and 3,785 controls, had AUC 0.95 in validation. In independent testing (646 cases, 638 controls) sensitivity was 87.8% and specificity 81.9%, with 7.3% nondiagnostic outputs, and it correctly reclassified 73.5% and 73.6% of indeterminate HFA-PEFF and H2FPEF results. Patients classified as HFpEF by AI had higher mortality (HR 1.9).
ai_technology: 3D convolutional neural network on echocardiographic video clips

evidence.tested: Testing used an independent multisite dataset and comparison with HFA-PEFF and H2FPEF scores.
evidence.unknown: Case-control labels are retrospective; prospective impact is unknown. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A 3D CNN classified HFpEF from one routine echo clip, with a nondiagnostic category for uncertain cases.
